main_sub: The Christian cross is a key to free you from the tempo-material illusion
header_desc: The encounter of the Condor and the Eagle symbolizes the definitive union between science and spirituality, allowing us to understand that human consciousness is not a byproduct of the material body but a fundamental property of the Universe. It is precisely the Primordial Consciousness that has the mission to reintroduce gnosis, revealing that each cerebral hemisphere is linked to a different plane of the cosmos: the timeless and divine corresponds to the pneuma, while the temporal and material pertains to the psyche. This shows that what the Christian tradition defines as the <q>rapture</q> is, essentially, a spiritual awakening known as the <q>Return to Divine Unity</q>.
left_title: The Return of Sophia: From the Prison of Yaldabaoth 🧠 to the Realm of the ONE ❤️
left_body: The Gnostic gospels, written almost two thousand years ago, hold the key to one of the greatest enigmas of modern physics: quantum gravity. The EGO has mass and creates the tempo-material illusion of the psyche 🧠; to counteract it, the cosmos offers us a Universal Consciousness, timeless and non-spatial —the ONE—, which allows us to return to the divine timelessness of the pneuma ❤️.
universe_light_text: Understanding that death is not an absolute end, but a transformation, frees us from ignorance. In the right hemisphere —our pneuma— resides the timeless and divine plane; the high-frequency spiritual plane | 999⟩ is the origin of the cosmos where the Invisible Father dwells. There lies the land of union and freedom (The Great Homeland).
center_text: Consciousness manifests through two fundamental states: the spiritual |ONE⟩ —represented by Pistis Sophia and associated with the right hemisphere ❤️—, and the physical |EGO⟩ —represented by the Demiurge Yaldabaoth and associated with the left hemisphere 🧠—. This shows us that we possess a free will of perception, which can be mathematically formalized as an inner product ⟨ONE ❤️|EGO 🧠⟩, reaffirming the maxim <q>The Kingdom of God is within you</q> (Gospel of Thomas, logion 3).
universe_mat_text: The human body is composed of carbon-12 (6p^+, 6e^-, 6n^0). In the left hemisphere lies the temporal and material plane, the low-frequency physical plane | 666⟩; the end of the cosmos where Yaldabaoth dwells. There is a place where: <q>war is peace, freedom is slavery, and ignorance is strength</q> (1984).
final_quote: When the Eagle of the North and the Condor of the South fly together in the same sky, Mother Earth will awaken and all humanity will heal.
p2_sub: Condor and Eagle: The flight of science and spirituality
cap1_title: Chapter 1: The Prophecy of the Condor and the Eagle { footnotesize color{golddark}(00:10 -- 01:07)}
cap1_desc: Premise and integration framework: the reconciliation between the South's intuitive wisdom (the heart, ancestral knowledge, and spirit) and the North's technological development (reason, science, and mind). The call for balance to initiate evolutionary awakening and transcend the state of duality.
cap2_title: Chapter 2: Quantum Gravity and Temporal Illusion { footnotesize color{golddark}(01:13 -- 02:42)}
cap2_desc: The fundamental clash of theoretical physics: General Relativity vs. Quantum Mechanics. Why Newton's and Maxwell's laws do not distinguish between past and future, Einstein's rupture of simultaneity, and the dissolution of linear time as a neural reconstruction of memory.
cap3_title: Chapter 3: Consciousness and Space-Time { footnotesize color{golddark}(02:47 -- 05:19)}
cap3_desc: The Faggin-Segarra conceptual ensemble: the body as a vehicle operated by a conscious quantum field outside space-time, where qualia reside. Consciousness does not arise from the brain but precedes it, converging with the First Consciousness and the Intelligent Designer free of time and space.
cap4_title: Chapter 4: Gnosis and Material Illusion { footnotesize color{golddark}(05:27 -- 08:39)}
cap4_desc: The Nag Hammadi discovery (1945) and the Coptic codices: the material cosmos conceived not as a home, but as a prison for the soul. The teaching of the Gospel of Thomas (Logion 3): Jesus did not come to found a religion of dogmas, but to free the inner spark from the prison of the Demiurge through remembrance (gnosis).
cap5_title: Chapter 5: The Realm of Light and the Prison of the Demiurge { footnotesize color{golddark}(08:43 -- 10:16)}
cap5_desc: The Demiurge Yaldabaoth — also known as the great architect of matter — is the creator of the sensible world, an egocentric god ignorant of true divinity. On the other hand, Sophia lies captive in the density of matter, awaiting the spark of awakening.
cap6_title: Chapter 6: The Dajjal and the Universal Hemispheres { footnotesize color{golddark}(10:23 -- 14:38)}
cap6_desc: Comparative eschatology and perceptual distortion: the figure of the Dajjal and the visual trick of the inverted paradise (the river and the fire). The mechanism of Orwellian doublethink (1984) as the cognitive prison of the ego, against Jesus' revolutionary message that dismantles the imperial slavery system.
cap7_title: Chapter 7: Reflections on Our Place in the Cosmos { footnotesize color{golddark}(14:40 -- 16:30)}
cap7_desc: In the end, the great paradox boils down to this: in the vastness of the cosmos — with its over two trillion galaxies — that's where Jesus' phrase resonates most strongly: 'The Father and I are one.' Could this have hidden a message about the deep connection between humanity and the cosmos?
sagan_quote: <q>The idea that God is a larger-than-normal white man, with a blazing beard, sitting in the sky and counting the fall of every sparrow is ridiculous. But if by God one means the set of physical laws that govern the universe, then there clearly is such a God. However, this God is emotionally unsatisfying... it doesn't make much sense to pray to the law of gravity.</q>
